Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time last week. We'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute product walkthrough next week focused on performance SLAs, security, and the dedicated deployment path you asked about. You mentioned the VP and CTO would like to join. Can you confirm whether the VP or the CTO needs to be on the full demo, or whether a short CTO pre-brief + VP join for the Q&A would suffice?

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Jul 6, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Jul 7, 14:00–15:15
- Thu Jul 8, 08:30–09:45

If the CTO is traveling, we're happy to:
- run a two-part session (CTO pre-brief 30m + full walkthrough with VP 45–60m), or
- keep the full demo and have Karthik cover technical deep-dive items if CTO can't join.

I've attached a draft agenda and a runbook for a two-part session so you can see how we'd split content.

If you prefer, send over the CTO/VP availability and we'll coordinate.

Thanks —

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the options and the materials. Quick update from our side: our VP (Rachel Park) definitely wants to be on the main session and will prioritize the time. The CTO, Tom, is traveling internationally the week of Jul 6 and likely only available for a short pre-brief on Mon Jul 5 or an early-morning slot on Jul 8 (CTO will be in transit most days).

Given that, the two-part approach sounds right: a 30m CTO pre-brief (technical risks + architecture questions) and a separate 60m walkthrough for the VP + broader team. Could you do a CTO pre-brief on Mon Jul 5, 09:00–09:30 PDT? VP session should be the week of Jul 6 — Rachel prefers morning slots.

Also: can you include estimated token/usage cost for the architecture scenarios in the agenda? Procurement will ask.

—Sarah
